days.details: 4–5 mi easy warm-up, 3 × Full Hascall Hill at 8/10 effort, 4–5 min easy between, easy spin home. Stop if a rep is 15+ s slower than the first.
days.actual: 5 × Full Hascall Hill (2:44, 2:49, 2:31, 3:00, 2:52), 7.5 mi, rep HR 146–162, max 172. Two more reps than planned; the third was fastest. HR stayed a bit under the 175–183 target.

days.details: Optional 30–45 min spin, or off. Keep it easy so your legs are fresh for Sunday's long ride.

40–50 mi on the Silver Comet, about 3–3.5 hours. Steady Zone 2 the whole way; ease off on the climbs to stay under the cap. Eat every 30–45 min and drink about a bottle an hour. Threshold 3 × 10 min moves to Tue Nov 3.
